a.lede: The US president provided little detail on the potential policy, saying others in his team were hearing about it for the first time.
a.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas

b.lede: The president wants U.S. data center companies to stay within U.S. borders or pay a hefty fee if they want to build in foreign countries.
b.title: Trump wants to ban US companies from building overseas data centers as bans slow development
